I haven’t touched this thing in weeks. I feel like I need to get it up and running.

Do I need to sign up on some random site to start mining?

Hi there,

Short answer: no, nothing shady. Your miner just needs to be pointed at a mining pool. Most people either use a public solo pool, where you only enter your own Bitcoin address and no account is needed, or a regular pool where you do register. Either way you set it in the miner's dashboard, and the payouts go to your own wallet.

Tell me which unit you have and I'll walk you through the exact settings. If you want hands-on help right now, JD and the community are quick on our Discord, https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, mention @nullhashrate.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
Can you tell if there l these pools are set up correctly? I think pool 4 is wrong. Thank you for your help.

Hi,

Pool 4 actually looks fine. It's our own pool, pool.harlolabs.com on 8888, with your address and a 10% share, and the blank password defaults to x.

The one I'd change is Pool 3. solo-bch.2miners.com is a Bitcoin Cash solo pool, and the worker field there is a bc1q Bitcoin address. Same algorithm, so the miner will happily connect, but any block found there pays to a BCH address, not that one. Either swap Pool 3 for a Bitcoin pool or drop it and give its 18% to Pools 1 and 2.

One more thing worth checking: that address ends in Harlo-Dev-Wallet, which is the demo wallet some units ship with. Make sure the bc1q address in all four pools is yours, not the factory one, or the payouts go somewhere else entirely.

Also update the firmware before you tune anything else. You'll find the newest build for your model, with release notes, on harlolabs.com, and an older build is the usual cause of odd pool readings like the 20 percent versus 18 percent mismatch on that screen.

If you want someone to look over the settings live, JD is on our Discord at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, mention @nullhashrate.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
